checks.claim: At 400 ppm of carbon monoxide, a person gets a headache within 1 to 2 hours, and it becomes life-threatening within about 3 hours
checks.why: AICO, FireAngel and Kidde all give frontal headaches within 1-2 hours at 400 ppm, with life-threatening exposure after about 3 hours. The 3-hour figure comes from alarm manufacturers, so treat it as a rough guide.

sources.title: What symptoms do you get at different carbon monoxide (CO) ppm levels? - FireAngel

checks.claim: A wood stove chimney must rise at least 3 feet above the roof where it passes through, and at least 2 feet higher than anything within 10 feet
checks.why: The 3-2-10 rule is described by flue-pipes.com as NFPA 211, and Chimney Insight says IRC R1003.9 mirrors it. These are secondary sources, and local codes may be stricter.

sources.title: Chimney Height Above the Roof: How High? (IRC and NFPA 211)
What Are the Building Codes for Chimney Pipes?
Chimney Height Calculator Based on Roof & Obstruction Rules

checks.claim: A wood cookstove oven can reach a hot baking temperature of around 230 °C (450 °F), though it has no thermostat and typical baking runs about 175–230 °C (350–450 °F)
checks.why: No source gives a typical wood cookstove oven temperature. 230 °C (450 °F) is the top of the general hot-oven range, so it is not a fixed value.

sources.title: What Temperature Should a Wood-Fired Pizza Oven Be? Guide

checks.claim: In French, cuisinière means both a cooking stove and a woman who cooks (the feminine of cuisinier)
checks.why: Wiktionary, Dictionary.com and French Today all list both senses: female cook and stove/range.
